# Step - where_p

`where_p` · category: [Filters](../../traversal/step_reference.md#filters)

Graphersal form of where(predicate), modulated by by().

## Forms

```text
where_p(arg1: any)
```

## Example

```rhai,graph=modern
g.v(1).as("a").out("knows").where_p(P.gt("a")).by("age").values("name").to_list()   // ["josh"]
```
